gate.heading: Before you play: flashing effects

blocks.p: This game contains flashing effects and fast, bright scenes. It is a test build and is still being checked. Some scenes may flash more often than the recommended limit of three flashes a second. If you or anyone in your family has photosensitive epilepsy, please do not play.
Reduce flashing is on and cannot be turned off in this build. It lowers some effects but does not remove every flashing scene. Stop playing at once if you feel unwell.

gate.under: You can stop testing at any time, for any reason. You do not have to explain.
gate.ai: Orb Combat EX is a one-person project. Orb directs it, and AI tools write the code and draft the art, animation, dialogue and design documents. Nothing in the game is generated by AI while you play: the fight director and the world are ordinary game code.

tester.p: This is a private test build for one named adult friend of the project. By using it you are telling Orb you are 18 or older. It was shared with you personally. Please do not pass it on, upload it, post it, stream it, or give your key or this folder to anyone. If you want to show it to someone, ask Orb first. You got this build through itch.io, a separate service run by another company, with its own rules and privacy policy. It sees your download, and if you claim your key with a free itch.io account, Orb can see your account name.

You may play it on your own computer or Steam Deck and tell Orb what you think. You may record or screenshot a problem to show Orb, and send that to Orb only. You may not post, stream or share footage or screenshots publicly, copy or sell the files, take the game apart, or reuse its art, writing, sound, code or name. All rights are reserved; the permission page that came with your key says the same in friendlier words. Delete this folder if Orb asks.

Nothing leaves your computer unless you send it. The game does not send reports by itself. To report a problem, use Send feedback or Save this match in the game. They put files in a report folder on your computer: your match, and copies of the game's own log files. The game also copies its logs there after a run that did not close properly. It removes folder paths and your account and computer names from those log copies, but it may not catch everything, so look at a file before you send it. Send it yourself to Orb's private report channel: [REPORT CHANNEL, given with your key]. That channel is a service run by another company, with its own rules and privacy policy, and the people in it can read your report and see your name there. What you send is also read with the help of AI services run by another company, so its contents leave Orb's computer. Please put no personal details in a report: no real name, address, email or account names. If you ask, Orb will delete your report files and messages from the report channel, and Orb's own copies, within 14 days. Those services may keep copies under their own rules, and Orb cannot remove what someone else has already saved.

permission: What you may do with Orb Combat EX during the Alpha
Thank you for testing. Here is what you may do, in plain words.
You may:
- play the build on your own computer or Steam Deck;
- tell Orb what you think, in reports, chat or conversation;
- record or screenshot a problem to show Orb, and send it to Orb only;
- suggest ideas, fixes, drawings or sounds (see "If you send something", below).
You may not:
- post, stream or share footage or screenshots of the build anywhere public, or send them to anyone else, without asking Orb first;
- give the build, its files or your download key to anyone;
- copy, sell, rent or re-upload the game or any part of it;
- change the game and share the changed version;
- take its art, writing, sound or code and use it somewhere else;
- use its name, characters or look to promote or sell anything;
- feed its art, writing or code to an AI model to train it.

Why it is this way. Orb Combat EX is an early, private test, and some of it is not ready for the public. All rights in the game, its art, writing, sound, code and name are reserved for now. That is the plain default, and it keeps every option open for later. It is not a reflection on you.

What comes later. Orb will decide about public code at Beta, the next stage. A later version of this page will say what players may do when the game is public, such as streaming and making videos. Nothing here promises any of it.

If you send something. If you send an idea, a fix, a drawing or a sound, you let Orb use it in the game, and Orb will credit you if you wish. You keep your own copy and your credit. You are not owed payment unless you and Orb agree it first. For anything bigger than an idea (code, art or sound you made), Orb will ask you to agree to a short contributor note first.

Credits. The game runs on the Godot Engine (MIT License) and uses the Open Sans font (SIL Open Font License 1.1), among other parts. Their notices are in the build, on the licenses screen, and in NOTICES.txt in your folder.

How the game was made. Orb Combat EX is a one-person project. Orb directs it, and AI tools write the code and draft the art, animation, dialogue and design documents. Nothing in the game is generated by AI while you play: the fight director and the world are ordinary game code.
Questions or a problem. Tell Orb through the private report channel that came with your key.
